summary: The Phase 3 browser check shows Spellweavers Run 2D started and playable with all four built-ins absent. The move screenshot shows a changed game state. The script cannot pass on a blank page.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] ux-browser-review: The Phaser 2D game has an empty accessibility snapshot because the interface renders in a canvas. The screenshots show game content, but the canvas does not expose that content to assistive technology. This is a known nonblocking limitation.
evidence: The audited HEAD is 29ad3aa3783be9f39411f14213e626280f278ab0, matching the final Green HEAD in green-p3-t7.log. The role base is recorded as the audited HEAD.
Read out/old-browser/check.json: game is spellweavers-run; started is true; moves is 6; errors is empty; state_changed is true; all four named built-ins are undefined in the page.

Read scripts/old-browser-check.mjs. It installs the deletion init script before navigation, checks all four built-ins, visits the demo URL, selects Spellweavers Run, advances through the reader and briefing, and waits for the Phaser renderer and game hook.
The script records pageerror events and console errors. It requires a non-null game state before and after the move and throws if the state does not change.
The start screenshot visibly shows the Spellweavers Run HUD, question panel, answer choices, forest scene, and player character. The move screenshot shows the answer progress and game scene changed.

The script cannot pass on a blank page: it waits for the demo ready signal, selects the game card, starts the Phaser renderer, requires a game object, and requires changed state. The inspected screenshots independently show the live game.
The page URL is http://127.0.0.1:5199/demo/index.html?qc=1&renderer=phaser. The selected game id is spellweavers-run.
green-p3-t7.log reports the command exited 0 and port 5199 was free after the run.
The empty Phaser accessibility tree is nonblocking. No broader visual-quality or audible-quality claim is made.
